glossary.definition: "Attachment" means any wire, wireless facility, cable, antennae facility, or apparatus for the transmission of text, signs, signals, pictures, sounds, or other forms of information installed by or on behalf of a provider upon any pole owned or controlled, in whole or in part, by one or more electric cooperatives.

glossary.definition: "Broadband provider" has the same meaning as in section 122.40 of the Revised Code.

glossary.definition: "Electric cooperative" has the same meaning as in section 4928.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: "Incremental cost" means pole attachment costs incurred by an electric cooperative for providing long-run service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: "Make-ready work" means, as determined by the nature of the work required, "make-ready," "complex make-ready," or "simple make-ready" as those terms are defined in 47 C.F.R. 1.1402.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: "Provider" means a broadband provider, telecommunications service provider, video service provider, or wireless service provider.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: "Telecommunications service provider" means a provider of "telecommunications service" as defined in section 4927.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: "Video service provider" has the same meaning as in section 1332.21 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4926.01 to 4926.60 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
"Wireless service provider" has the same meaning as in section 4927.01 of the Revised Code.
